exercises.title: BuiltIn Keywords
exercises.description: Practice using common BuiltIn library keywords like Log, Sleep, and Set Variable.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
BuiltIn Keywords Test
    # Write your code here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
BuiltIn Keywords Test
    Log    Starting test
    Sleep    1s
    ${status}    Set Variable    Complete
    Log    ${status}
hints: Sleep accepts time values like '1s' for seconds
Log can print both strings and variables
Set Variable creates or updates a variable

exercises.title: String Library

exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
String Operations

hints: Library imports go in the Settings section

exercises.title: Collections Library

instructions: Create a list ${fruits} with: apple, banana, orange
Get the length of the list and store in ${count}
exercises.initialCode:
*** Settings ***
# Import library here

*** Test Cases ***
List Operations
    # Write your code here
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
List Operations

    ${count}    Get Length    ${fruits}
    Log    ${count}
hints: Create List is a BuiltIn keyword that creates a list

exercises.title: User Keyword
instructions: Create a user keyword called 'Greet User'
The keyword should log 'Welcome to Robot Framework!'
Call the keyword from a test case
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Test Custom Keyword
    # Call your keyword here

*** Keywords ***
# Define your keyword here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Test Custom Keyword
    Greet User

*** Keywords ***
Greet User
    Log    Welcome to Robot Framework!
hints: Keywords are defined in the *** Keywords *** section
Keyword name should be on its own line with no indentation
Keyword body is indented with 4 spaces
Call the keyword just like built-in keywords
